title: Kobalos Backdoor Investigation
description: Investigate a Kobalos backdoor on a target host and identify its indicators of compromise.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: Welcome to the Kobalos Backdoor Investigation scenario. Your goal is to identify a Kobalos backdoor on a target host and locate its indicators of compromise.

levels.title: Access the Target Host
levels.cloud_content: Connect to the cloud-based sandbox using SSH with the provided credentials.
levels.local_content: Start your local virtual machine and connect to it via SSH.

levels.title: Identify Running Services
levels.content: List the running services on the target host and identify the service named 'sshd'.
levels.solution: Use the `netstat` command to list open network connections and find the service named 'sshd'.

hints.title: Hint 2
hints.content: Look for a service listening on port 22 (default SSH port).

levels.title: Locate Malicious Files
levels.content: Find the file named 'e094dd02cc954b6104791925e0d1880782b046cf' on the target host.
levels.solution: Use the `find` command to search for the specified file name.

hints.title: Hint 2
hints.content: Look for the file in common directories such as /usr/bin or /etc.

levels.title: Analyze Network Connections
levels.content: Identify any outbound SSH connections from the target host to the IP address '151.80.57.191'.
levels.solution: Use the `ss` command to list open network connections and find SSH connections to the specified IP address.

hints.title: Hint 2
hints.content: Look for an SSH connection with destination IP '151.80.57.191'.
